landing.feature.triage.title: AI Triage in Seconds
landing.feature.triage.desc: Describe your emergency in any language. Our AI instantly identifies what you need and surfaces the right contacts.
landing.feature.languages.title: 3 Supported Languages
landing.feature.languages.desc: Communicate in English, Hindi, or Kannada. No language barrier in an emergency.
landing.feature.nearby.title: Locate Nearby Services
landing.feature.nearby.desc: GPS-powered map shows the nearest hospital, police station, fire station, and pharmacy in real time.
landing.feature.procedures.title: Step-by-Step Procedures
landing.feature.procedures.desc: Clear, verified instructions for filing FIRs, reporting cybercrime, applying for documents — and more.
landing.feature.offline.title: Works Offline
landing.feature.offline.desc: Core helpline numbers are cached for offline access. Emergency info when you need it most.
landing.feature.privacy.title: Privacy First
landing.feature.privacy.desc: Your sessions are encrypted. Data is never sold. Login is optional — most features work anonymously.
landing.builtForIndiaDesc: Every feature is designed around real-world emergency scenarios across urban and rural India.
landing.everySecondCounts: Every second counts. Our AI triage is available 24/7 — no login required.
